cohort: Two unrelated males harboring non-recurrent complex Xq28 rearrangements associated with MECP2 duplication syndrome.
finding: The study describes two different molecular mechanisms of Xq28 rearrangements (an intrachromosomal DUP-TRP/INV-DUP and a de novo (X;Y) unbalanced translocation) that both lead to MECP2 duplication syndrome, with phenotypes consistent with previous reports, except for cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in one patient.
